title: Diagnose, repair and requalify original MLS interoperability regression

acceptance_criteria.description: Identify actual failing boundary and repair it while preserving the protected Haskell federator contract.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Original isolated MLS fails with five Go peers while its Haskell counterpart passed; actual transport/RPC evidence must establish attribution. Reproduce concrete cause in candidate test and correct it, or hand off with proven different cause; never suppress assertions, widen statuses or guess root cause.

acceptance_criteria.description: Qualify exact corrected Go federator executable/image against original and frozen contract evidence.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Required Go format/tidy/verify/vet/race/build/vulnerability/license checks, unchanged frozen35, original federator5 and actual isolated original MLS pass. Corrected whole47 Haskell-worker/five-Go peers baseline passes with exact identities and cleanup0. Rebuild optional image matching executable, trusted-CA/default-health/SIGTERM smoke. Unchanged prior peer proofs reused; no production or remote action.

acceptance_criteria.description: Review bounded correction and preserve upstream defaults, protected oracles and historical evidence.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Exact source/binary/image receipts, failures/unrun checks recorded, delegated same-author review and scope/framework checks; no unsupported compatibility restoration.

evidence.command: Original strict MLS with five Go peers; bounded trace observes get-mls-clients transport error, generic521. Attribution unresolved; no behavioral fix. Sole Go federator run passed; categorized five-Go run also passed intermittently.

handoff: No behavioral repair attributed: single observed get-mls-clients transport error is intermittent; two unchanged categorized five-Go original MLS runs passed. Temporary service.go diagnostics removed, exact claim-base source restored. Keep compatibility null and retain all failed evidence. Await concrete failing transport category/reference attribution; do not repeat broad diagnosis. Independent whole-worker contract/construction may proceed; final exact six-service original interoperability remains mandatory and cannot qualify with an unresolved failure.
